_readme: Which child sits where, as seen by this camera.
Copy this to seats.json and then redraw it properly:
Boxes are [x1, y1, x2, y2] normalised 0-1, so the plan survives a
change of camera resolution. They are drawn generously: the box only
has to contain the child's face, not fit it exactly.
topic_code is the lesson on the board. It is attached to every flag so
the home robot knows what to re-teach that evening; without it a flag
says a child struggled but not with what.
